formal_statement: have x1 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ)) := {(0 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), (1 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), (3 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), (9 : Fin (13 : ℕ))}; ∃ (x2 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x2 ∧ x2.size ≤ (63 : ℕ) ∧ (∀ (x3 x4 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), x3 - x4 ∈ x1 → (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun ((13 : ℕ) + (13 : ℕ)) x2 fun (x6 : Fin ((13 : ℕ) + (13 : ℕ))) => Decidable.decide (x6 = Fin.castAdd (13 : ℕ) x3 ∨ x6 = Fin.natAdd (13 : ℕ) x4)) = Bool.true) ∧ ∀ (x3 x4 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ))), (∀ x5 ∈ x3, ∀ x7 ∈ x4, x5 - x7 ∉ x1) → (∀ (x6 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), {x7 ∈ x3 | x7 - x6 ∈ x1}.card ≤ (2 : ℕ)) → (∀ (x7 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), {x8 ∈ x4 | x7 - x8 ∈ x1}.card ≤ (2 : ℕ)) → (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun ((13 : ℕ) + (13 : ℕ)) x2 fun (x8 : Fin ((13 : ℕ) + (13 : ℕ))) => Decidable.decide ((∃ x9 ∈ x3, x8 = Fin.castAdd (13 : ℕ) x9) ∨ ∃ x9 ∈ x4, x8 = Fin.natAdd (13 : ℕ) x9)) = Bool.false
plain_statement: Plane of order 3. Some circuit of AND and OR gates, at most two inputs a gate, with at most 63 gates is true at every incident point-line pair and false at every input with no point on one of its lines, no three of its points on a line and no three of its lines through a point.
title: A step toward: Search: an order-3 plane circuit of at most 63 fan-in-two AND/OR gates, true at incident pairs, false at every generic maximal false input
